{{Quote|Ascension cables!|Captain Rex, to his troops in Torrent Company during the Battle of Teth|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
[[File:AscensionCable-TCWf.png|thumb|right|250px|DC-15A blaster rifles were equipped with ascension cables.]]
An '''ascension cable''' was a type of [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]] that was used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] and [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]], which saw widespread usage by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], were equipped with ascension cables. A grappling extension provided ascension cable functionality to a [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster]]; [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] used the extension during the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|Battle of Ringo Vinda]].
